claims.text: Used for hereditary or acquired angioedema, and for ACEi angioedema that = severe, progressing or refractory (it USU resolves about 24 to 48 hrs after stopping the drug)
claims.quote: Angioedema due to ACE inhibitor use usually resolves about 24 to 48 hours after stopping the medication. If symptoms are severe, progressing, or refractory, treatments used for hereditary or acquired angioedema can be tried.

claims.text: Options: C1 inhibitor concentrate, FFP, and possibly ecallantide (inhibits plasma kallikrein) or icatibant (blocks bradykinin)
claims.quote: They include C1 inhibitor concentrate, fresh frozen plasma, and possibly ecallantide (which inhibits plasma kallikrein, required for the generation of bradykinin) and icatibant (which blocks bradykinin).

claims.text: Ecallantide must ⍉be self-administered and carries a boxed warning for anaphylaxis
claims.quote: Ecallantide must not be self-administered and carries a boxed warning for anaphylaxis.

claims.text: Sebetralstat (PO plasma kallikrein inhibitor): acute HAE attacks, age 12 and older
claims.quote: EKTERLY ® is a plasma kallikrein inhibitor indicated for the treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE) in adult and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older.
